name.la: Parvum alphabetum monachi in schola Dei
name.en-US: The Little Alphabet of the Monk in the School of God
name.pt-BR: O pequeno alfabeto do monge na escola de Deus

description.la: Parvum alphabetum monachi in schola Dei: dialogus inter discipulum et magistrum, regulae vitae spiritualis secundum ordinem litterarum, cum benedictione.
description.en-US: A short dialogue between disciple and master: the rules of the spiritual life set out in alphabetical order, love of obscurity, kindness, guarding the heart, solitude, poverty, and the blessing at the end. Latin only: Pohl's critical edition (Freiburg 1904), from a raw OCR of the printed volume; no public-domain English translation has been found.
description.pt-BR: Breve diálogo entre discípulo e mestre: as regras da vida espiritual em ordem alfabética, o amor da obscuridade, a benevolência, a guarda do coração, a solidão, a pobreza, e a bênção final.

sources.edition: Thomae Hemerken a Kempis Parvum alphabetum monachi, ed. M. J. Pohl (Freiburg: Herder 1904), Opera omnia III; archive.org raw OCR.
sources.description: One chapter; the rules are set as separate paragraphs. Line numbers, running heads and page breaks stripped by script; Pohl's critical apparatus and introduction not imported. Raw OCR: drop capitals garbled and some slips remain after the scripted lexicon repair.
